title: model catalog publication: release assets are published only from master pushes, after the catalog PR merges
answers: Why did the model-catalog/latest release assets not match the merged catalog after a PR merged?
Where does the scheduled model catalog job open or update the automated catalog PR?
Can a pull request run upload model catalog assets to a GitHub release?
Which workflow moves the model-catalog/latest tag and what token does it use?
body:
Path: `.github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml` runs the catalog job on schedule, workflow_dispatch, and pull_request. Scheduled and manual runs regenerate the catalog JSON in mlflow/utils/model_catalog via `dev/update_model_catalog.py`; the job `create-pr` opens or updates the automated catalog PR, and the job `publish` handles publication.
Rule: Generation and publication are separate. `create-pr` runs only for schedule/workflow_dispatch with changed output. `publish` runs only for `push` on `mlflow/mlflow` master, moves `model-catalog/latest` to `github.sha` before calling `dev/publish_model_catalog.sh`, and authenticates with `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` (not the App token). Pull-request runs validate generation only. Do not add release uploads to the generate/PR path.
Symptom: Release assets could be built from generated content before the catalog PR merged, so downloads did not match the merged catalog commit.
Constraints: Triggers on master pushes that touch mlflow/utils/model_catalog/*.json. Publication is unavailable to pull_request code, so untrusted PR code never gets write access for publishing. Publication is retried by rerunning the workflow. `cancel-in-progress` is enabled only for pull_request runs, because `create-pr` and `publish` push changes.
applies: Changes to the model catalog release, tag, or catalog PR automation in the update-model-catalog workflow.
says: Downloaded model catalog release files do not match the changes merged into main.
The latest model catalog download still shows older data after merging updates.
Prevent catalog release assets from publishing before the review pull request merges.
Make sure official model catalog publications only trigger from merged master updates.
Unapproved pull requests should not be able to upload model catalog releases.
search: In .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml, model catalog publication is decoupled from generation so release assets publish only on pushes to master after catalog changes merge. The create-pr job regenerates catalog JSON via dev/update_model_catalog.py on schedule or manual dispatch, while the publish job moves the model-catalog/latest tag and runs dev/publish_model_catalog.sh using secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN. Pull-request runs validate generation only and never upload release assets, while master publication triggers only on changes to mlflow/utils/model_catalog/*.json.
